claims: Olivier Rioux is a basketball player.
Olivier Rioux currently plays for the Florida Gators.
Olivier Rioux was recognized by Guinness World Records as the tallest teenager in the world in 2021.
Olivier Rioux gained attention early via international youth competitions.
Olivier Rioux became the tallest player to ever play in an NCAA tournament game.
Olivier Rioux became the tallest player to ever appear in a college game.
Olivier Rioux made his debut in an NCAA tournament game.
